seriesTitle: The Fall of the House of Usher

episodes.title: A Midnight Dreary
episodes.summary: A wealthy CEO faces a criminal investigation amid tragedy, trauma — and a supernatural threat. The Usher family learns an informant lurks among them.

episodes.title: The Masque of the Red Death
episodes.summary: Motivated by money and revenge, Perry hosts an exclusive masque-rave that takes a twisted turn. A young Roderick pitches a revolutionary new opioid.

episodes.title: Murder in the Rue Morgue
episodes.summary: In charge of the Ushers' publicity, Camille conspires to spin controversy in her family's favor and expose the grim details of her sister's experiments.

episodes.title: The Black Cat
episodes.summary: Leo adopts a black cat who soon brings evil — and a mysterious woman — into his home, while Roderick struggles with terrifying hallucinations.

episodes.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
episodes.summary: Victorine inches closer to testing her heart technology on a patient until tensions erupt between her and Alessandra. Dupin makes a chilling confession.

episodes.title: Goldbug
episodes.summary: Pym digs up disturbing information on Verna. With her marriage on the decline, Tamerlane hosts a turbulent product launch that shatters expectations.

episodes.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
episodes.summary: A furious Frederick sets out to handle unfinished business. Madeline receives an ominous message at an old haunt. Dupin grows wary of Roderick's motives.

episodes.title: The Raven
episodes.summary: In 1980, Roderick and Madeline seize a chance to cement their fortune — for a price. Decades later, the remaining Ushers reckon with the consequences.
